editorial.marketOverview: Neutral — Downside Risk persists across November 12, 13 and 16. Wednesday's semiconductor-led rebound preceded the Nvidia leadership crisis. Overnight futures weakness is an early warning, not proof of a Thursday cash-session breakdown.
editorial.whatChanged: The curated feed adds Foxconn's stronger profit and optimistic AI-rack outlook as positive demand evidence, while senators' export-record preservation request increases Nvidia regulatory scrutiny. Neither has a verified attributable US equity reaction. No confirmed Nvidia board resolution or CEO removal.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Positive AI hardware demand and severe Nvidia governance risk coexist. Wednesday's Nasdaq +1.60% and SOX +5.7% cannot be synchronized with the subsequent NVDA after-hours fall and overnight Nasdaq-100 futures decline. The November 10 Treasury 10Y–2Y spread is +25.7bp, not a current yield curve quote; fresh volatility, breadth, yields and FedWatch remain unverified. Oil prices were lower in an earlier separate observation.
editorial.threeDayPath: Thursday November 12 tests Nvidia communications and the first regular-session QQQ/SOX response alongside claims and Treasury reopening. Friday November 13 brings PPI inflation risk. Monday November 16 tests follow-through and whether semiconductor leadership returns or deteriorates.
editorial.bullCase: Official orderly leadership clarification, resilient NVDA, broad SOX outperformance versus QQQ, supportive Cisco and Applied Materials results, improving breadth and contained yields/VXN would justify a bullish upgrade. Foxconn offers fundamental support but not price confirmation.
editorial.bearCase: Confirmed abrupt CEO removal or prolonged uncertainty plus sustained NVDA-led semiconductor selling, QQQ weakness, higher volatility/yields or hot PPI would validate bearish downgrade. Regulatory oversight could amplify but is not yet enforcement.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Nvidia board announcements, time-aligned Thursday NVDA/QQQ/SOX cash trading, breadth, 2Y/10Y yields, VXN/VIX and FedWatch; track jobless claims, Cisco/Applied Materials earnings, Friday PPI and actual market responses to Foxconn and export-control headlines.
